nodes.label: Nosecone Cap 3D-Printed Prototype
nodes.description: Physical 3D-printed prototype of the nosecone cap, shown in hand. The part is orange/amber colored FDM-printed plastic, cylindrical cup-shaped with a flat top and stepped/flanged base. Visible layer lines indicate FDM 3D printing. The design includes a small notch/slot feature on the side wall. The prototype appears to be a fit-check or form validation piece for the nosecone assembly.
